result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, consumer-facing tone built on the headline 'Abbott is in the business of life' and lifestyle language ('live your best life', 'live fully'). Commitments are stated absolutely in first-person plural ('our purpose', 'our commitment'). Patients and individuals are addressed first; employees, governance and financial matters are absent. Most text is chrome or legal disclaimers, with little operational detail.
